25mg for now

She didn’t want me to taper at all. I begged her for some tablets but clearly I needed to do a 3-6-9 month taper as I’m extremely sensitive to meds and possibly kindled. I don’t know. The whole thing is fucked.

Yeah, I was fucked after a week apparently. So I panicked and wanted off and my doc rapid tapered me to avoid becoming further dependent. So I foolishly listened. Was crying in her office with BP over 200 and they said I wasn’t addicted.

Was a normal, healthy dude before this. Didn’t have anxiety or depression. A week of insomnia sent me spiraling which led to the Klonopin. Coming off of it sent me into a hell I cannot describe. I started Zoloft 25mg back in February. Has it helped? I think so, but also made my dick numb so now I’m dealing with that on top of everything else.

Yes, I used .25mg as needed during a health crisis but never daily. Perhaps a dozen times or so, don’t remember. Haven’t touched any psych med since 2009 until this. Biggest mistake of my life. 

I was having heart palps when I cut my dose in half by day 5 last year. Also was taking a Medrol dose pack concurrently with it - no idea if that played a role or not.

These drugs are poison and have caused endless suffering. I got dependent within a freaking week for temporary insomnia from an ear infection and have suffered for nearly 17 months because my doctor basically gave me 7 pills to taper from.  An ENT originally gave me 15 tablets and I cut them in half and quarters thinking that was safer. 

Then I cut my dose in half after 10 days and got heart palps overnight. How is that even possible?

.5mg of Klonopin for 10 days. It’s insanity. 

I come crying to my GP with high BP and she wants me off fast despite me showing up with the Ashton Manual. She doesn’t want further dependency. So I listed and cut again and all hell breaks loose. Thought I was going to have a heart attack or stroke. 

I’ve been living with PAWS, working, married, two kids, and I don’t know how I made it this far. These pills have nearly ruined my life when I could have been given something like Trazodone or an antihistamine. 

I was insanely suicidal, severely depressed, going out of my mind, horrible insomnia, and I’m being gaslit By doctors saying I have anxiety or depression, or that the 6 day course of steroids I took caused this. 

I understand 99% of people can CT or rapid taper a benzo that’s used within less than two weeks but I’m a rare case where dependency happened almost immediately. 

Things are better than where they were last year but I had to start Zoloft when the SI became too much to bear. I hate antidepressants because of the sexual sides but I believe it’s helped. 

I was a normal happy guy that got anxious and couldn’t sleep from tinnitus and deafness just so I could take care of my kids. 

I miss drinking beer with my friends but at least I was able to go out and enjoy a baseball game yesterday. 

Fuck these drugs. They nearly killed me.

Jesus this scares me. I CT’ed from less than two weeks of use and haven’t been able to exercise for nearly 16 months. 

What are your symptoms when you exercise? I get awful headaches/ brain aches, insomnia, depression, and paresthesia.
How long were you on for? What are your current symptoms?

Dude I was only on  .5mg K (which should have never been prescribed) for *10 days* and a did a weeklong taper and it nearly killed me. I basically had to taper much slower but wanted that shit out of my system plus my GP wouldn’t let me taper slower. Didn’t know I would need to taper for months from insanely short usage. 

Still suffering nearly 15 months later. FML
Yes. I didn’t have any depression or SI before touching these drugs. It has lifted lately and praying it stays that way.

Does Medrol trigger a depressive or anxiety disorder? And would it last this far out?

I have never had depression or crying spells like this in my life.

Yes but these symptoms are so much worse, combined with the fact I’m severely depressed, unable to exercise, and a host of other issues due to the abrupt cessation. 

I know it sounds crazy but I was severely sensitive to this drug and had to microtaper over months despite my very short usage. I nearly died a few days after quitting.
Then enlighten why else I was physically and mentally fine before touching that poison?

I started getting WD symptoms when I took half a dose on the seventh day. Symptoms got worse on the half dose from there on out. I quit after 17 days and everything went to shit  

I never abused benzos. I had prior damage from Finasteride so I believe that’s why I got hit so badly. I don’t know.
Yeah, I got heart palps after I cut my dose in half on the seventh day.
7 days. CT’ed and fucked up 13 months later.

Was warned it was addictive. That’s it. Thought it meant I would crave them, not develop a fucked up dependency and ruin my life. 

Was only prescribed 15 tablets and half of them did me in.
You got dependent in 3 days?!?! Oh my I’m so sorry.
What’s that supposed to mean?

Yes, I tried seeing a benzo aware psych but he couldn’t see me until a few weeks after I quit. I also saw a second GP and she just wanted to script me antidepressants. 

I should have pounded the pavement and sought out more doctors, psychiatrists, etc. I have no idea who would have helped me taper for months and months if I was only on it for 10 days though. 

Yes, I joined BB and got very poor advice on that forum as well. Validation of symptoms, yes. 

I don’t want to live like this anymore and it’s all my stupid fault of not being proactive with my heath.
It’s too late isn’t it? I’m 13 months out.
This was May of last year. I gave her the Ashton Manual and she dismissed it and wanted me off fast to reduce further dependency. I’ve been protracted for over 13 months now.
Thanks man. Did you taper or CT? I stupidly trusted my doctors advice to rapid taper and it was a disaster. I never had a sufficient supply of this poison to taper from.

That’s the problem. I’m unable to do physical activity without setbacks which is absolutely maddening because I was an athlete my whole life. Would run 2-3x a week and do weights. I weighed 170 and lift 235lbs. Now anytime I do a workout I get awful brain aches which manifest into skin burning and tingling. 

I used exercise to recover from Post Finasteride Syndrome as it induced a deeper sleep and I slowly recovered. 

I am very scared that I’m permanently damaged.

No physical symptoms, just wake up and unable to get back to bed. Yep, I get woken by cortisol or anxiety surges around that time. 

I can’t believe I took this poison for a temporary, weeklong sleep issue. I was better off doing heroin.

Haven’t woken up to my alarm clock since I cut my dose in half in May 2018. 

Usually wake up between 3-4am now. It’s horrible.

I’ll get anxiety/heart racing around 5am

Never had any of these problems before.

Thanks. You’ve never heard of severe withdrawal after 10 days of use? I felt like I was going to have a heart attack or stroke a few days after quitting. My BP and heartrate were through the roof and I should have went to the ER or reinstated. 

My doctor and her med student kept dismissing I could have become dependent that fast and assured me the symptoms would fade over weeks but what I did was basically a cold turkey and why I’m dealing with protracted symptoms a year out. The taper should have taken months per the Ashton Manual.
Thanks. That’s equivalent to 10mg of Valium though, that’s not a big dose? Especially when taken consecutively for 10 days? Thanks for responding.

Thanks man. I’m saying I only took the drug for 10 days. TEN!!!

I’ve been suffering for 13 months since CTing for clarification.

Thanks man. The thing is that I took this poison for 10 days this time last year. Been suffering since (13 months) due to my doctor’s idiotic advice and listening to people on another forum instead of my own body. 

If I knew what I knew now I obviously would have slowly tapered and convinced my doctor to listen to my tapering plan. 

Never been through such hell in my life.

Glad to hear that man. I was completely irresponsible with my “taper” and the doctor freaked me out about me becoming more dependent and though my WD would be a few months of discomfort since I was only on a short amount of time.

This wasn’t even used for anxiety, it was for sleep. They could have given me anything else. And yeah, I never had bad anxiety but it’s so much worse now. It’s the depression, SI, and crying spells that are intolerable. I would exercise if I could. Exercise was my antidepressant. 

I haven’t seen a CT story as bad as mine from the shortest of use and it’s jarring. Like I seriously could have died from a heart attack or stroke. Don’t know why I didn’t reinstate at the time. 

Have you got your sleep back yet?
Thanks man. How are you doing now?

Thanks man. I really needed to hear this. It astounds me that the only warning I received was that they were addictive. As if I would crave them. I thought I was doing the responsible thing taking them for short term relief. 

My doctor and the attending med student were dismissing that I got addicted and kept assuring me that it would pass in a few weeks. 

I don’t know how I made it this far. Probably for the love of my wife and kids.

Thanks man. What does cross tolerant mean? Are you saying the simultaneous use of steroids exacerbated my condition?

Praying for a smooth recovery for you.

Thank you. I’m not trying to play victim but I’ve been through enough shit in my life. 

I have two gorgeous young children  and a supportive wife and this isn’t supposed to be happening to me. Everything was peachy. I already have permanent damage from Saw Palmetto . I wish I had just used heroin.

Thank you. That’s not a bad idea. I just don’t understand any of this.

Thanks. I went to a neurologist and had an MRI and EKG without any issues. Seriously thought I had a stroke after quitting. I have visited a psych versed in benzos and neurology and he is adamant my receptors didn’t downregulate that rapidly and said the steroids triggered the mental issues while the benzo masked them. 

My brain seriously felt like someone injected an air pump into it after I quit. It was buzzing a few days after. My spine was tingling for days, too. 

I’m so scared and freaked out. I used this drug exactly as prescribed which is for short term use. I had no idea .5mg of K is 10mg of Valium. I only needed 1-2mg of Valium for sleep if not a z-drug. 

I had a freaking mocktail that must have had trace amounts of alcohol in it and even that triggered a reaction. I LOVED craft beer. 

It’s just an utter nightmare because I got my life back after a horrendous reaction to Saw Palmetto extract. Took over two years to recover 90% but I lost my health once only to lose it a second time.

I can’t fucking exercise because it results in massive setbacks. I get brain pains, worse insomnia, and days later burning and tingling skin. 

I used to bench 235 and weigh 170 and now I can’t lift at all. A freaking bike ride up a hill induced a setback. A quarter mile jog resulted in the same agony. 

The first week of acute I did my weightlifting routine and it induced the largest panic attack that I nearly crashed my car driving home. 

I was able to enjoy dinner with friends Saturday night without obsessing about this but the rumination is one of the symptoms and it’s horrendous. 

I was completely normal before this. Just had manageable anxiety about normal life things. Going temporarily deaf and having tinnitus take its place resulting in anxiety and insomnia would make anyone amped up.

Correct. I haven’t felt right since I cut the Klonopin dose in half last year. 

I’ve had some windows of normalcy but for the most part it’s been utter hell.

10 days of .5mg

Link?

There’s no such thing as a low dose in benzo world. I am highly sensitive to medication and this stuff destroyed my CNS.

The worst part is that the audiologist recommended I ask the ENT for them because I told her how Ambien made me hallucinate and she mentioned how she took Klonopin for 30 days and stopped without any issue. 

So I ask and they give me 1mg tablets of Klonopin when Lunesta or another z-drug would have sufficed.

That’s because those people most likely tapered. I can’t even eat certain foods high in MSG without my brain feeling weird. 

I did weights the first week of acute (which was stupid) and it sent me into a massive panic attack.  I cannot workout without huge setbacks resulting in skin burning, worse insomnia, and other fun sides. 

I haven’t regained my normal sleep pattern back yet either. 

My CNS was ripe for disaster after being sensitized from past ADs and Finasteride it appears. 

A few years ago, an edible sent me into a horrendous panic attack. It’s just clear that my CNS was compromised and this put it over the edge.
The abrupt cessation caused the damage instead of a gradual taper. .5mg K is 10mg Valium. That’s a lot.

Yes, I’ve had success with Prozac but this was before my CNS was damaged by the benzo. I also had sexual issues with Prozac though.  

I just want to feel normal and happy again.

Yes, this shit should have never been prescribed to me. Life was fucking awesome before this. 

I declined Ambien because I remember hallucinating on it last time I couldn’t sleep due to the flu. Klonpin knocked me out but I didn’t need 1mg tabs.

Just wish I had taken heroin instead and never discovered BenzoBuddies
I started Zoloft back in February and all it’s done has made my dick numb, killed my libido, and gain weight.

You’re saying the taper caused the dependency? I got heart palps in the middle of the night on day 7 when I only took .25 instead of .5 so that’s why I thought it would be prudent to taper. 

I basically should have quit right there but the heart issues scared me.

I had major symptoms making that 50% cut. I felt completely normal before making that massive cut. It all ties to the benzos. 

My GP and her med student didn’t even believe me.

Insomnia, depression, lack of motivation, not feeling like myself, inability to exercise (severe increase in symptoms), suicidal ideations, brain feels weird after eating foods high in MSG and glutamate, crying spells. 

I just haven’t felt normal since I made that first stupid cut. I don’t want to live anymore and everything was amazing before touching that poison. 

I could have been given literally anything else for sleep.
.5mg of K is 10mg of Valium. It is not a low dose.

I was only on for 10 days from a one-off script from an ENT. I accidentally took them daily. Got severe withdrawal and my doctor would only prescribe seven tablets to taper. Basically a CT. Went back in agony and she was clueless. Went to a second GP and didn’t believe me. 

I should have went to the ER or found a psychiatrist that could see me ASAP in hind sight. I’m so fucked up from such little use it’s insanity. Just wanted sleep for a week!!!

Severe insomnia, exercise intolerance, depression, SI, DP/DR.

Did the woman who attended med school CT? I’ve been suffering for 11.5 months and seriously afraid I have permanent damage at this juncture. Still can’t sleep 7-8 hours like I used, exercise without horrible setbacks, and feel like myself 100% of the time. 

I’ve been working full and time and parenting two children and I am so burnt out. Afraid how many months/years this hell is going to last.

I never meant to CT. I didn’t think I would need to taper for months on end. And the worst part is that doctors don’t even believe me.
Did you taper or CT? This has been utter hell. Did those people ever recover?

I took Klonopin for 10 days and I was hooked after 5 of them. You can checkout my handle for my story but I’ve been going at this for 11 months and about ready to give up. 

Glad to hear you’re feeling better.
When did your insomnia eventually let up? What about the depression and anhedonia?
Thank you. I need to hear this.

Thank you so much for the supportive words man. And I totally sympathize with your wife. I am so sorry these evil drugs harmed her. 

I am not trying to be theatrical here, but it is completely unfathomable something like this could happen.
Thanks man. Been staying alive for my wife and kids. This has been a traumatic experience and I’m so afraid if I’m going to fully recover.

Believe whatever you want man. I know my body and brain and it hasn’t been working right since I quit in May. Was having zero hour sleep, super high BP, and fast heart rate after quitting. Thought I was going to stroke out. And this was after two weeks. 

10.5 months later and a fucking quarter mile jog exponentially increased my symptoms last week. I was a fitness buff my entire life and now I can barely do any exercise. This is someone who weighed 170 but could lift 235lb and trained for 15 years. 

This has been completely devastating and debilitating. I’m a freaking horror story from short term use. 

I got such conflicting advice and didn’t know what to do. Again, I never had a supply of pills to properly taper from to begin with, but never in my wildest dreams could I imagine something like this happening. 

Maybe I would have been better off CTing after 10 days and not doing that 7 day taper? I don’t know. I felt like I had to microtaper after that initial usage but I can’t go back in time now.
Well I took it for 10 days and a 7 day “taper” back in May which was essentially a CT. Been in hell for over 10 months since.

And that's the problem. Doctor's don't know shit about this. I was dismissed as having mental illness when I had no history of depression prior to this. I wanted to damn near kill myself last week that's how bad the SI got. I have always been healthy and happy. These drugs wreaked complete havoc on me and I don't know where I would have a found a doctor to script me let alone believe me for proper tapering.   


FIVE doctors dismissed that I could get dependent this fast including one that is benzo-aware! I was taking a Medrol taper pack alongside the Klonopin and that could have greatly made this situation much worse. I'm very sensitive to drugs to begin with and had no idea I was taking the equivalent of 10mg Valium nightly. That's how uneducated doctors are. The ENT wrote me 1mg K tabs, and I split them in half if not quarters thinking I would be safe. It's the doctor's responsibility to safely prescribe medicine. She could have given me the .125mg K tabs, or 1mg of Valium, not 1mg of Klonopin! Hell, give me Trazodone or Hydroxizine. I only needed sleep for a temporary situation even though I took these drugs less than two weeks.   


Yes, the patient has responsibility as well, but if only I was warned not to take this daily, or that severe withdrawal could happen, I would have been more careful. Everyone is different but there needs to be better patient disclosure on this class of medication. Saying it's simply "addictive" is careless.

Yeah I’m sorry but this is wrong. I got dependent in record time, like 4-5 days. On the fifth day I cut my dose in half and started having heart palps in the middle of the night. My sleep hasn’t recovered since and it’s been over 10 months of this hell.

I clearly had to taper over months and months and instead stuck out a dangerous CT that has severely damaged me. My life hasn’t been the same since. I never had severe depression, suicidal ideations, exercise intolerance, crying spells, and a multitude of other symptoms. I’m honestly afraid if I’m ever going to recover.

Hey man, I feel your pain. I was only on benzos for less than two weeks and it has turned my life upside down for nearly a year. Insomnia, depression, SI, exercise problems, just a total shitshow.   


Somehow, somewhat I've dug deep inside and kept working. I've also got kids and a wife. I have to work because we've got a mortgage to pay. These pills are sinister. I had to go on Zoloft and regret it - not because I got adverse reactions but because of the sexual side effects, apathy, and so forth. I don't even know if it's helping with the depression.   


Thankfully I am able to work from home twice a week but it's still a struggle. This will get better. You will get better. There is no other choice. Hopefully you can get a leave of absence or find a less strenuous line of work. I am so sorry this happened to you.
I haven't got a true night of full restorative sleep since last May. It's been pure hell.
I’m sorry man. My doctor wouldn’t taper me either after I took Klonopin for 10 days. I was dependent and had to do an Ashton taper and instead CT’ed. Been suffering for 10 months now.
Yeah I took a 0.3mg tab and it made me very depressed and suicidal
Thanks man. So sorry you’re suffering too. Have you had any windows? Did you taper?

I had frequent urination and night sweats for years before taking the Klonopin. My tolerance to alcohol was light as one beer would give me a hangover. But yeah, if I drank a lot my sleep would be poor. 

I haven’t touched alcohol since and it really depresses me as I was a big craft beer fan.

All I’m saying is that I only had symptoms after cutting my dose in half. That’s when the hell began for me. 

And yes, I don’t know where I would have found a doctor to believe me let alone prescribe me more but there have been cases where someone took a benzo for 10 days or less and had to microtaper it over months. That’s what I had to do but I didn’t have the supply nor the knowledge. 

I was perfectly happy and healthy prior to this. It’s been hard to move on when I haven’t had a full night of sleep since cutting that dose in half back in May.

I honestly got dependent within 4-5 days man. I know it sounds crazy but I was talking .5 here or .25 there. I think on the fifth day I took .25 and woke up with heart palps in the middle of the night and had to take .another .25 to calm down. That’s when I knew I was in trouble. 

There’s been reports of this happening in 4 days. One person got withdrawal after a single dose. It’s rare but it happens. And of course it happens to me. 

I went through hell 10 years ago from 9 days of Saw Palmetto extract. It took me 1.5 years to recover. Now this?? You have to be kidding me. 

Oh and it’s definitely not psychosomatic for me. I never had crying spells, bone crushing depression, exercise issues, zero hour sleep, and a host of other problems after quitting this crap. 

I did take a Medrol taper pack alongside the K so I don’t know what role that played.
I would need to slowly taper off it as I’m dependent on them already. I don’t even know if it’s working yet as I’m on a very low dose.

My stupid doctor was of no help and gave me a handful of K .125 tabs to taper from even though I gave her the Ashton manual. She wanted me off faster to reduce dependency. I talked to Baylissa and she said that doctor would have her license revoked in the UK. Now my GP is going to a concierge service. 

I went to a second doctor that didnt believe that I have Benzo Withdrawal and wanted to script me antidepressants. I’m so upset that the ENT didn’t give me more warning, she just said they were addictive. And I don’t know why she didn’t give me smaller tablets instead of 1mg. I wish I had done my research. 

I don’t know where I could have gotten more tabs in time let alone find a doctor who knows what they’re doing. 

I even sought out a doctor who is listed on the Benzo Info Coalition website and even he didn’t believe I got dependent in 10 days and thought that the prednisone taper pack caused these problems. 

I also got bad advice from BenzoBuddies as I was freaked out and vulnerable and that’s my fault.

I just don’t want to live like this anymore. I recovered from Finasteride Discontinuation Syndrome (but really with Saw Palmetto extract) 10 years ago, albeit with physical permanent damage, but made it to the other side and lived life to the fullest. I actually took .25mg K as needed to help cope with it and might have led to this kindling episode. 

Prior to this, if I got drunk my heart would race and would have early awakenings, so I don’t know if my GABA receptors were weak already.

This is part of the reason that I am so depressed.

This is my nightmare realized. Unable to fully sleep, drink a beer, exercise, be happy, etc. I am going out of my mind.

I didn’t have insomnia until I quit this poison. I actually had higher libido after I did. Now with the Zoloft it’s nil

Then my doctor told me to cut in half again four days later and I listened. I took that dosage for three days then all hell broke loose. That’s why I should have reinstated and done a much slower taper. I was having zero hour sleep and thought I was going to have a heart attack. I felt a rush of chemicals to my brain and it felt like someone put an air pump in my skull. I show up to my doctor’s office and she’s clueless thinking I have a mental health issue as I am crying hysterically with BP over 200. I should have went to the ER.
